principles: Schema and policy remain the only execution authority.
Semantic recall may only retrieve registered route candidates.
Pairwise reranking may only select among the retrieved authorized candidates.
Unsupported requests fail closed through calibrated abstention.
No backend may synthesize a tool, endpoint, field, argument, credential, or side effect.

candidate_architecture.route_local_thresholds: not yet selected; blocked on #204/#205 development score diagnostic
candidate_architecture.threshold_semantics: raw winner is fixed before its route-local score/margin boundary; failure abstains and never falls through to a lower-ranked route

motivation: Wrong-tool errors are rare in the current baseline, while operation-fit abstention and wrong-endpoint errors dominate.
The existing candidate-fit stage only suppresses candidates and does not use its accepted option to route.
A bounded retrieve-then-rerank surface is simpler than the current gate cascade and gives the strongest semantic scorer direct control over the final registered route.
Route-local calibration is retained as a safety layer because global scalar thresholds cannot satisfy quality and unsupported-rejection goals simultaneously.
policy: Architecture may be implemented before score-surface diagnostics complete, but no route-local threshold map may be frozen until the preregistered tuning-eligible diagnostic is analyzed. Calibration and blind corpora remain forbidden for tuning.
